title: Republic Day greeting
hook: Happy Republic Day from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Happy Republic Day from all of us at Galvor.

On this day the Constitution came into effect, and a young republic wrote down what it wanted to be.

Wishing you a proud and restful 26th of January.
alt_text: Festive greeting on a violet background: Happy Republic Day. To the country that wrote down what it wanted to be. Warm wishes from all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: To the country that wrote down *what it wanted to be.*
slides.sub: Warm wishes from all of us at Galvor.
